name: Match the Vehicle
tagline: The same empty space is not right for every arrival.
brief: Match ordinary cars, electric vehicles, and large vehicles to the correct spaces.
context: The lot now has standard spaces, charging bays, and wide spaces for vans and trucks.
narrative: A mixed queue is arriving. If the broad fallback rule runs first, electric cars and large vehicles consume the wrong resource. Build an ordered policy that handles special requirements before ordinary vehicles.
objective: Serve all eight vehicles and make no category mistakes.
learningObjective: Resource matching: inspect requirements, place specific rules first, and leave the general case as a fallback.
intelligenceExplanation: The starter controller sends every waiting vehicle to a standard space. Add the electric and large cases above that fallback so the first matching rule selects the correct resource.
hint: Order the rules as electric, large, then the existing general standard rule.
hints: A broad hasWaitingVehicle rule also matches electric cars and trucks.
Specific rules must appear before the broad fallback in a top-to-bottom decision flow.
Use carElectric → park-charging, then carLarge → park-large, then hasWaitingVehicle → park-standard.
